end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners using shape edges and meeting points. Ayaan explained that a triangle remains a three-sided shape when turned, and later corrected counting one square side twice by tracing back to the starting point. At home, ask them to trace everyday shapes with a finger, counting each side once and each corner where two sides meet.
